title: APA Table
summary: Build a descriptive-statistics table in a Quarto document with knitr::kable(): italic headers, two decimals, a caption, no code showing.
hints: One row per astronaut first: `filter(mission_number == 1)`. Then `mutate(decade = paste0(floor(year_of_mission / 10) * 10, "s"), age = year_of_mission - year_of_birth)`.
`group_by(decade) |> summarise(n = n(), M = mean(age), SD = sd(age))` makes `age_table`.
`knitr::kable(age_table, digits = 2, col.names = c("Decade", "*n*", "*M*", "*SD*"), caption = "Age at First Flight by Decade")`, in a chunk with `#| echo: false`.
